LESSON: CONSTITUTION OF MADINA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.5: Constitution of Madina

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Constitution of Madina
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the Madina constitution important to history of Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Constitution of Madina.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the Madina constitution important to history of Islam?
2. What role did the Ansar play in the settlement of the Muhajirun?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the role played by the Ansar in the settlement of Muhajirun in Madina

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
